capabilities.name: Credential identity and sessions
facts: Stable credential-principal identity and application-account link; normalized unique login email and display name.
Better Auth credential records and native secret hashes, never plaintext passwords.
Session principal, session proof, issuance and expiry Instants; current revocation state and actual current-session identity.
Thirty-day session lifetime with renewal when remaining life is below fifteen days; account credential/email revision used to invalidate stale proofs.
invariants: Login email is unique after normalization; each credential belongs to its actual principal.
A session cannot confer access after its authoritative revocation or account suspension.
Credential changes cannot rewrite CRM identity or spare a client-selected session.
capabilities.retention: Account-owned data is hidden immediately on deletion request, held solely for cancellation for 30 elapsed days, then coherently purged; recovery-copy expiry is at most seven days after live purge. Shared independently owned facts retain only necessary attribution.
capabilities.notes: Sources: REQ-IDN-001, 008, 009, 028. Keep Better Auth-required adapter storage; do not invent a parallel credential implementation.

capabilities.name: Atomic admission budgets
facts: Purpose/kind, normalized identifier or privacy-preserving identifier hash, trustworthy IP or its hash, attempt/reservation time and exact rolling-window occupancy.
Login and password-change failures each use separate 5/identifier and 20/IP budgets per fifteen minutes; successful login clears only the matching identifier/kind failures.
Registration counts every submitted attempt at 3/trusted IP/hour, including success and refused or malformed attempts.
Reset requests and email-change requests use separate 3/identifier/hour and 10/IP/hour budgets; email-change identifier is the existing own login, not proposed target address.
invariants: Concurrent reservations cannot exceed the applicable shared budget.
Failure of the budget store does not admit authentication or registration.
Unknown IP may omit only optional IP axes; registration refuses without its required trustworthy IP.
capabilities.retention: Keep attempt times only as needed to enforce the declared windows and recover live reservations; no permanent identifiable attempt history is required.
capabilities.notes: Sources: REQ-IDN-001, 002, 007, 008, 009. Invitation creation/resend limits are separately recorded in CAP-A-006 and CAP-A-009.

capabilities.name: Purpose-bound credential and cancellation proofs
facts: Actual request-owning account, hashed single-use token, closed purpose, expiry, consumption/supersession and captured credential/email revision.
Email-change request has normalized proposed mailbox and a twenty-four-hour expiry; reset request expires after one hour.
Cancellation-only proof binds exact deleting subject, current request ID/revision and original account or requesting Owner.
Committed mutation receipt and security-mail intent identify successful email/password change without exposing native proofs.
invariants: At most one live reset request per account and one live email-change request per account.
Token use is purpose-bound, serialized and single-use; credential/email change invalidates outstanding reset/email proofs.
Email-change target remains globally unique; login-email changes leave independently editable CRM email unchanged.
Cancellation proof never creates ordinary content access.
capabilities.retention: Expire or consume secret proofs at their purpose deadlines; cancellation proof cannot outlive its request deadline. Account deletion purges private proofs; shared security receipts retain minimal attribution.
capabilities.notes: Sources: REQ-IDN-007 through 009, 030, 032. Security-mail failure cannot erase a committed credential result.

capabilities.name: Resumable account registration and provisioning
facts: Credential-principal association, explicit registration state pending_domain or active, validated account type planter/sending church/network/Discovery and stable intent identity/digest.
Exact claimed invitation and subject revisions, created plant or organization identity, accepted seat and account-linked Person where the chosen registration requires them.
Explicit Discovery identity when registration creates no seat; completed domain receipt and required mail intents.
Initial plant creation occurrence and once-only Phase 1 creation provenance, independent of reading or existing-journey attestation.
invariants: One application account per credential principal; normalized mailbox equality alone cannot grant another existing account access.
pending_domain carries no seat or relationship authority.
Claim, grant, Person link, domain receipt and required intent succeed together; retries return the original completed result.
At most one active tenant seat per account, including concurrent registration, conversion and invitation acceptance.
capabilities.retention: Account-owned data is hidden immediately on deletion request, held solely for cancellation for 30 elapsed days, then coherently purged; recovery-copy expiry is at most seven days after live purge. Shared independently owned facts retain only necessary attribution.
capabilities.notes: Sources: REQ-IDN-002, 003, 013, 016, 030. Beta enablement/code is deployment configuration, not a customer-managed gate catalog. Display name is an account fact; current schema may source it from the auth principal.

capabilities.name: Current seats and independent platform grants
facts: Actual account, exact plant or typed sending-church/network tenant, accepted Owner/Admin/Member role, current accepted/ended state and revision.
Accepted/joined Instant and originating invitation or explicitly labelled account-creation fallback; dated removal and role-change actor/reason history.
Explicit platform grant bound to immutable principal identity, independently of email, tenant role, Person title or affiliation.
Named moved/remaining duty handoff receipt and access-dependent leader removal reference for seat removal.
invariants: Each account has at most one active seat across all tenants.
Role and owner shape are closed; each referenced tenant is the actual matching kind.
Actual Owner cannot be removed or changed by generic seat administration.
Person/account link, ministry title and affiliation never constitute platform or seat grants.
capabilities.retention: Ended seat and qualification/team history remain attributable under their owning lifecycle. Account purge removes live personal access and scrubs retained shared attribution; no ownership-transfer history engine is required.
capabilities.notes: Sources: REQ-IDN-005, 019, 029; ADM-002. Actionable-duty facts stay with their owning follow-up/task capabilities.

capabilities.name: Addressed first-seat invitations
facts: Exact inviting workspace, actual inviter, normalized recipient mailbox, advertised Admin/Member role and hashed purpose token.
Pending/accepted/expired/revoked state, revision, creation and thirty-elapsed-day expiry, accepted account and action Instant.
Last resend Instant/cooldown and token generation/supersession; invitation-attempt times for exact workspace/address rolling-window count.
Claim receipt, resulting seat/Person link and security/notification mail intent.
invariants: One pending invitation intent per exact workspace/address; no more than three new attempts for that pair per thirty elapsed days.
Persistent sixty-second resend cooldown; acceptance/revoke/resend compete on the same current revision.
Only proven addressed identity may claim one first seat; already seated or incompatibly associated Discovery cannot silently move tenancy.
capabilities.retention: Token authority ends at expiry, revocation, replacement or consumption. Keep dated accepted invitation provenance for roster/history; private recipient data follows deletion ownership, and no indefinite token-secret retention is needed.
capabilities.notes: Source: REQ-IDN-017. Sender-visible status does not include account-resolution details.

capabilities.name: Plant and organization profiles
facts: Plant name, independently nullable street/city/region/country/profile description and confirmed church IANA timezone.
Plant inactivity warning and alert day thresholds; weekly digest weekday/hour, default America/Chicago and Sunday 16:00.
Organization immutable sending-church/network kind and identity, bounded name/contact email/phone/description and independent locality.
Profile revision and attributable changes; past schedule Instants and LocalDate obligations retain their original meaning.
invariants: Trimmed name is nonempty; organization kind is immutable.
Weekday is 0 through 6, hour 0 through 23; inactivity values are 1 through 365 and warning is less than alert.
Profile locality fields may be absent independently; plant street has no organization-oversight disclosure.
Same-tenant revision checks protect concurrent profile edits.
capabilities.retention: Plant-owned facts and history survive personal account deletion with minimum necessary attribution. Plant deletion hides them immediately, holds eligible content only for 30-day cancellation, then purges live content; recovery copies expire within seven days of coherent live purge. No additional fixed history limit is specified.
capabilities.notes: Sources: REQ-IDN-011, 026. No billing, configurable permissions, public organization deletion, ownership transfer or inferred geography is added.

capabilities.name: Explicit Discovery profile and conversion lineage
facts: Owning account, explicit preplant profile/setup answers, current/retired-by-conversion state and profile revision.
Current independent sending-church/network association identities, each consent and history.
Conversion intent, chosen carried-forward relationships/sharing choices, created plant/Owner/Person identity and conversion Instant.
Once-only Phase 1 church-creation provenance, distinct from journey answer or readiness.
invariants: Discovery has no organization seat and cannot be inferred from a missing seat.
Only actual profile owner converts; account lock protects conversion against first-seat claim and relationship changes.
Conversion preserves only disclosed chosen relationships and cannot create a second active seat.
capabilities.retention: Account-owned data is hidden immediately on deletion request, held solely for cancellation for 30 elapsed days, then coherently purged; recovery-copy expiry is at most seven days after live purge. Shared independently owned facts retain only necessary attribution.

capabilities.name: Typed affiliation invitations and independent link history
facts: Exact typed plant-to-sending-church, plant-to-network, sending-church-to-network, Discovery-to-sending-church or Discovery-to-network endpoints.
Normalized mailable recipient, inviter identity, hashed purpose token, pending/accepted/expired/revoked state, current revision and thirty-day expiry.
Creation-attempt times by subject/address for the rolling thirty-day maximum of three; resend/supersession facts and response actor/time.
Independent accepted/ended affiliation state and revision for each exact pair; historical actor/organization/subject/source invitation/Instant/reason.
Same-intent claim/sever receipt and retryable coarse relationship notice, including no-effect replay.
invariants: Every endpoint kind matches its actual plant, Discovery account or organization kind; pair links cannot duplicate current accepted relationships.
No duplicate pending subject/address intent; exact receiving organization alone approves its side.
Multiple independent affiliations may coexist and ending one cannot end another or grant a seat.
A revoked/ended link has no current body entitlement even if historical events survive.
capabilities.retention: Keep minimal legitimate counterpart relationship history after source deletion, without retained private plant bodies or contacts. Discovery-owned private association content follows account deletion. Token authority expires and ordinary rejoin never resets existing consent.
capabilities.notes: Sources: REQ-IDN-020, 021, 027. No special rejoin engine or configurable general tenant graph is required.

capabilities.name: Independent per-organization consent
facts: Exact plant and receiving organization pair with live relationship identity and consent revision.
Independent booleans for People, Meetings, Tasks, ministry Teams, Wiki, activity push and released shared findings.
Self-start all-OFF defaults and disclosed first accepted invitation category defaults; actual prior choices retained across rejoin.
Actual consent change actor/Instant and coarse relationship-notice receipt where required.
invariants: One policy per exact plant/organization pair; missing/revoked relationship or policy confers no consent.
Category values are closed and independently editable; omitted categories preserve current values.
Organization notification preference cannot override plant consent; shared_findings is the sole released-health/NI permission.
No finance/facility/background/coach/private-care categories exist.
capabilities.retention: Plant-owned facts and history survive personal account deletion with minimum necessary attribution. Plant deletion hides them immediately, holds eligible content only for 30-day cancellation, then purges live content; recovery copies expire within seven days of coherent live purge. No additional fixed history limit is specified.

capabilities.name: Private avatar and Person photo references
facts: Actual owning account or same-plant Person, generated immutable private object reference, MIME/type, byte length and display version.
Upload ready/pending/failed state and orphan/old-object cleanup intent after atomic reference replacement.
Selected stored source/survivor photo and protected object references in merge/inverse receipts.
invariants: Nonempty verified JPG/JPEG/PNG/WebP, at most 3 MiB.
Only existing stored authorized photo choices may enter merge; reference commit precedes old unreferenced byte cleanup.
A failed save keeps old reference; cleanup cannot delete any currently or inverse-retention referenced object.
Person photo belongs to the exact tenant; account avatars remain private self-owned facts.
capabilities.retention: Avatars follow personal deletion; Person photos follow plant ownership. Keep prior photo bytes only while a live reference or permitted merge inverse needs them. Orphans are tracked for cleanup; no indefinite image-version archive is required.
capabilities.notes: Sources: REQ-IDN-006, PPL-005, PPL-025. Authenticated account/Person version routes expose no arbitrary raw keys or storage bearer URLs.

capabilities.name: Confirmed personal timezone and stable private calendar
facts: Confirmed personal IANA timezone, independent of plant/device timezone; calendar revision belongs to immutable original account author.
Stable private-week identity/ordinal, frozen start/end Instants, Monday LocalDate and frozen zone.
Pending requested zone and first strictly future Monday transition boundary; open-week continuity across repeated zone edits.
invariants: Missing confirmed preference remains missing; there is no silent timezone fallback.
One stable ordinal per author calendar, without rekeying historical weeks or duplicate rollover.
Save/correction/zone edit/rollover serialize on the same author calendar revision.
Private week existence and transitions cannot enter shared audit, logs, telemetry, Evry, model input, organization data or exports.
capabilities.retention: Account-owned data is hidden immediately on deletion request, held solely for cancellation for 30 elapsed days, then coherently purged; recovery-copy expiry is at most seven days after live purge. Shared independently owned facts retain only necessary attribution.

Once-only onboarding completion Instant and material source revision; actual creation Phase 1 provenance remains separate.
Named incomplete/remaining provisioning effects in receipt for safe resume.

Lead answer grants no account authority and imports no unselected template structure.
Unsure/skip answer is not phase attestation; creation needs no six-article completion gate.
Omitted launch date cannot silently clear an existing plan.

Self suppression-clear can affect only current proven own mailbox.
Enabled organization push cannot authorize withheld plant data; private-care preferences are absent.

capabilities.name: Finite personal and plant deletion
facts: Exact actual account/plant subject and original requester; immutable request identity, request revision and active/pending_deletion/purging/purged lifecycle.
Requested Instant and cancellation deadline exactly thirty elapsed days later; current cancellation result with independently still-valid grants.
Typed owned-reference/byte/effect cancellation manifest, completed chunks, failures and current purge claim generation.
Coherent live-purge completion Instant, nonresetting recovery-copy expiry at most seven days later and actual provider cleanup state.
Minimal body-free current subject/request/access witnesses and witness checkpoint usable after live root removal.
invariants: Self requests account deletion; actual current plant Owner alone requests workspace deletion; organizations are not requestable deletion subjects.
Normal access stops at request commit; restricted cancellation succeeds only strictly before deadline under request lock/revision.
livePurgedAt is absent until eligible live database and private byte cleanup is coherently complete.
Restore and recopy cannot reset expiry, resurrect revoked grants or expose uncertain/expired subjects.
capabilities.retention: Eligible private content is held for cancellation only through the thirty-day window, then purged coherently. Recovery copies become ineligible within seven days after live purge. Body-free current witnesses outlive copies only to prevent resurrection; shared independently owned records retain minimum attribution. Physical universal day-37 erasure is not promised.
capabilities.notes: Source: REQ-IDN-032, recovery deletion contract. No separate transfer/rejoin product or public organization-delete console is required.

capabilities.name: Identity settings shell and oversight projections
capabilities.retention: No additional product persistence. Existing identities, seats, relationships, consent, facts and lifecycle govern these reads.
capabilities.notes: Sources: REQ-IDN-004, 010, 023, 024, 028. Fixture switching is isolated development configuration. Settings drafts/deep links, request Origin checks, safe returns, directory/health aggregates and network roster counts add no customer data beyond the referenced capabilities. Domain health/release producers remain independently owned.

facts: Stable Person identity, owning plant, real display identity and optional first/last components; names are bounded to 255 characters per component.
Independent nullable email/phone/street/city/region/postal code/country, closed source/source details and profile summary notes.
Current seven-stage recruitment status, recorded creation Instant for deterministic pagination/export and expected mutation revision.
Explicit adult/child/unknown classification with dated actor/reason correction lineage; date of birth is optional and not proof of classification.
Independently editable contact email, distinct from login mailbox and identity link.

Names, shared email or phone are not unique human identity, and intentional duplicates remain valid.
Adult classification, stage, account link and commitment state are independent; no background-check fields exist.

observations.observation: reports_to_team_id and reports_to_role_id store dormant hierarchy facts, while REQ-TEAM-012 uses a fixed Leadership-template root and explicitly adds no reporting-hierarchy editor. These references are not required to render the retained organization view.

type and template_key may duplicate predefined identity; responsibilities_seeded_at and phase_introduced suggest read-time seeding or automatic phase setup. REQ-TEAM-003/007 require optional exact imports and an explicit accepted/declined versioned offer; they do not require those additional source-mechanism flags.

team_role.status duplicates filled/open if independently stored from current membership. person.first_genuine_commitment_date is derivable from valid dated commitment history and merge lineage. REQ-TEAM-005 and REQ-PPL-026 require accurate projections, not extra mutable caches; any retained cache needs a named query and coherent invalidation reason.

current_commitment is a boolean, while REQ-PPL-026 distinguishes active, withdrawn and unknown supported lifecycle. Adding more redundant booleans would be heavier and still lose uncertainty. Keep the actual lifecycle/evidence distinction; this observation is a mismatch, not permission to drop commitment history.

attachment_object_ids is beyond ADM-001, which explicitly has no screenshot-upload feature. account_id and original_author_account_id are both present; the requirement needs one immutable private owner/original author unless an actual differing ownership use is identified.

allowed_categories JSON adds an editable-looking permission payload to a deterministic closed serializer with one validated category and public-area label. operation_effect_id ties publication to the assistant effect stack even though ordinary safe publishing is automatic. Frozen payload/destination/hash, factual outcomes and reconciliation remain necessary.

Several link resources repeat independently scoped relationship state/lifecycle. IDN-020/021 require exactly five typed endpoint shapes and enforceable independent links, not one physical table per pair type. This is a consolidation candidate only if endpoint type/FK integrity, invitation authority and counterpart retention remain explicit.

Seat and relationship invitations repeat addressed token/expiry/revision/resend/claim history. Shared lifecycle storage may reduce repetition, but their grant effects and typed targets differ and cannot become generic unenforced type/ID authority.

Training-specific event and general correction envelopes may repeat actor/time/reason/revision facts. A shared typed history envelope is a possible reduction; saved assignment applicability, genuine tenure episodes, immutable requirement versions and earned/revoked/redo history are substantive obligations, not redundant copies to delete.

created_at, updated_at and revision appear broadly, including expiring attempt buckets or immutable history/version rows. Require each timestamp/revision to serve an actual pagination, deadline, observed occurrence or concurrency purpose; immutable events generally do not need generic mutable-row bookkeeping.

Native CSV import requires frozen reviewed rows, resumable per-row outcomes and an idempotent final/partial receipt. REQ-PPL-018 does not itself require a full assistant execution/effect/result decomposition; keep per-row identity and failure/retry semantics without automatically copying that stack.

Generic tagged scope fields and repeated owner stamps on operational envelopes can be heavier than exact typed subject/manifest identity needs. Recovery facts may live in an authenticated encrypted manifest plus a minimal index/journal. Current witnesses must remain independently current and survive live-root removal, so they cannot be collapsed into the stale backup image.

Four-Cs and interview facts need concrete human criteria and chronological occurrence/recorded lineage; they do not need stored latest pointers or derived score totals. No observation proposes hiding constrained human criteria in opaque JSON or replacing them with model assessment.
